{{Quote|Blackmoon Two to Eight, come with me; we're going to do a couple of strafing runs and see what pops up.|Yakown Reth during the Battle of Borleias|<ref name="RD" />}}
'''Blackmoon Eight''' was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] of a member of [[Blackmoon Squadron]], a [[New Republic Defense Fleet]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] that fought at the second [[Battle of Borleias (Yuuzhan Vong War; Second)|Battle of Borleias]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. During that battle, several members of Blackmoon Squadron, including Blackmoon Eight, were led on a series of strafing runs by [[Blackmoon Leader]] [[Yakown Reth]] against [[Yuuzhan Vong]] ''[[rakamat]]'' creatures.<ref name="RD" />
